'''Nosh Droma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]]. Droma was an agent of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], though he pretended to be a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="GeharrIncident" />
